text:
Anya: Quick sync — pricing thought: introduce a small pool of 'burst credits' customers can draw from on PAYG to avoid buying reserved capacity for spiky workloads. Good middle ground between committed vs pure usage. Thoughts?
Mike: Love the idea. Need to surface who benefits most. Enterprise customers buy reserved for predictability; startups prefer PAYG but hate throttle surprises. Burst could reduce churn for the latter. :thinking:
Sam: We should evaluate via RICE. Impact likely high (retention for spiky apps), reach moderate, effort medium (billing + UI + quota systems). Quick sketch: ```Feature | R | I | C | E | Score
Burst credits | 6 | 7 | 4 | 8 | 120``` Not exact but directional.
Rita: Also require per-route rate limits + per-project buckets. Customers ask for per-route throttles so a single noisy route doesn't burn their burst. If we add burst credits, tie them to scopes.
Jordan: Concern: complexity of UX + accounting. How do we show remaining burst? Do we prorate conversion when reserved is purchased mid-month? Ops complexity adds SRE cost.
Elaine: Sequencing proposal: 1) ship per-route rate limits and visibility (low risk), 2) add burst credits as add-on for PAYG (moderate), 3) integrate billing/reservation conversion (higher). Launch criteria per step: monitoring for spikes, clear UX copy, rollback plan.
Mike: Agree on sequencing. For prioritization we can run a mini-RICE for each step and include customer asks as weight on Impact. Which customers are pushing for this? Rita, can you surface top 3 accounts and their ARR risk?
Rita: On it — will DM specifics. High level: two midmarket customers churn-risk if we don't offer soft cap/burst. One ISV wants unpredictable inference for 24-48h events.
Anya: Acceptance criteria for MVP burst credits: - configurable monthly burst quota per org - visible counter in console and billing emails - automatic fallthrough to rate-limited PAYG when exhausted - docs + helpcenter article. Launch metric: reduce churn intent signals by 30% in trial cohort.
Sam: Quick tech notes: implement as a separate token pool that decrements before the PAYG meter. Fallback order: burst -> reserved pool -> PAYG, with events emitted to billing stream. Small proto in infra should fit in 2 sprints if we reuse quota infra.
Jordan: If infra dev is 2 sprints, UX + billing will be 1-2 more. Cost: ~4-6 engineer-sprints total. Worth it if retention lift validated.
Anya: Let's gate on two things: 1) evidence from 2 customers willing to pilot, 2) RICE score > 100 after we fill numeric estimates. If both true, move to alpha.
deploy-bot: Created ticket PI-451: "Burst credits: PAYG soft-cap pool" and linked to epics/PRD.
Mike: OK. Next action: Rita to gather pilot customers + ARR, Sam to run detailed RICE with engineering estimates, Elaine to draft sequencing and launch checklist. We'll reconvene in 3 days. :thumbsup:
